title: 36 Hours in Ogunquit, Me.
abstract: LOBSTER shacks share Ogunquit, Me., with some of that state's top restaurants, just as stores selling plastic lobster souvenirs bump up against serious art galleries. The town, 90 minutes north of Boston, offers a lot of what people want in a Maine vacation -- and a few surprises. Page 4.
